title: Free SQL→ER diagram tool, runs in the browser, nothing uploaded
summary: A free browser-based tool that converts SQL schemas into Entity-Relationship (ER) diagrams instantly, with all processing done locally client-side to ensure complete data privacy.
problem_solved: Solves the problem of visualizing complex SQL database schemas in an intuitive, graphical ER diagram format without needing external tools or uploading sensitive data.
why_valuable: It provides a free, privacy-preserving solution for developers and database architects to quickly visualize and understand SQL schemas directly in the browser.
